description: Report the progress of a parse started with start_parse: status (pending, running, completed, failed, cancelled), the current phase and percentage, and the error when it failed. Takes the graphId start_parse returned, or the canonical graphId a completed parse reports.

graphId.description: The diagram's graphId, as list_diagrams or get_diagram returns it. The id start_parse returned also works.

name: get_parse_status
title: Check a parse
